likely_to_grow.label: An Insider Advantage poll released 10/15 shows Ken Paxton at 49% and James Talarico at 48%.
John Cornyn, Karl Rove and the Republican establishment are working to help James Talarico beat Ken Paxton.
Ken Paxton will win the Texas Senate race by about 2 to 4 points.
James Talarico raised $64 million in the third quarter, a fundraising record, while Ken Paxton raised $18 million.
